payload.title: [tenant-app-isolation-7] listProjectionObjects helper ignores ctx.appId and always reads the _default partition
payload.description:
AUDIT FINDING tenant-app-isolation-7 (low/isolation, confidence=medium, verify-votes +2/-0)

FILE: apps/server/src/projections/helpers.ts
LINES: 20-25

WHAT: listProjectionObjects(ctx, type) calls `ctx.store.listObjects(ctx.tenantId, type)` — the 2-arg tenant overload — which defaults appId to DEFAULT_APP_ID (store.ts:1109-1116). FrickProjectionContext does carry `appId` (registry.ts:57-63, set from the originating write in store.ts:1238-1243), but this ergonomics helper drops it, so a per-app projection that uses the helper reads `_default`-app objects regardless of which app's write triggered it.

IMPACT: A per-app projection handler using listProjectionObjects observes the wrong app's object set (the `_default` partition) — cross-app read for projection logic. Limited to projections that use this helper in a genuine multi-app server with per-app projections; single-app `_default` is unaffected.

SUGGESTED FIX: Pass ctx.appId through: `ctx.store.listObjects(ctx.tenantId, type, ctx.appId)`. Audit other ctx.store calls in projection helpers/handlers for the same omission.
